name: xmuse
description: xmuse 2 sidebar for Claude Code: room members, timeline, approvals and @-wake-up for a local multi-agent room

hubUrl.title: hub URL
hubUrl.description: xmuse hub address, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:43117. Leave empty to read hub.json from the state directory below, then fall back to http://127.0.0.1:43117. /xmuse hub <url> overrides it for this machine.

stateDir.title: room state directory
stateDir.description: Directory that holds the room's hub.json ({"port": ...}). Optional; <project>/.xmuse/hub.json is also tried.

pollWaitSeconds.title: long-poll wait (seconds)
pollWaitSeconds.description: How long one /v1/view long poll may hang (1-30).

registryDir.title: local registry directory
registryDir.description: Directory holding the room registry (hubs.json) and the sidebar key (sidebar.key). Empty means XMUSE_REGISTRY_DIR, then the platform default (%LOCALAPPDATA%\xmuse on Windows).
